title: Bare '&' / unterminated '&#65' in text: libxml2 silently stops parsing forever (zombie connection)
notes: Observed with lxml 6.1.3 / libxml2 2.14.6: a '&' not followed by a name, or a char ref without ';', in element text never raises; the pull parser silently stops emitting anything for the rest of the connection (no pong, no routing, socket stays open until the client goes away). D-23: Rust treats a malformed reference as a stream error -> disconnect 'XML Syntax Error' (steps 3-4 then observe nothing on either side; a send to a server-closed client is a no-op).
